rules.name: Pause ads for aged stock
rules.description: When an FBA SKU has units that will enter the LTS band within 14 days, pauses the ad-group advertising NEW products of the same productType and creates a 15%-off promotion for 14 days. Cuts ad spend on fresh stock and accelerates liquidation of the aged units.

actions.reason: Aged stock liquidation — fresh-product ad-group paused

actions.message: Pausa ad-group + promo 15% per SKU sotto soglia LTS

rules.name: Reduce bids on ACOS spike
rules.description: When a campaign ACOS exceeds 1.0 (spend ≥ sales, break-even or worse) with spend ≥ €100, lowers the ad-group default bid by 20% (floor €0.05). Defensive: prevents budget haemorrhage on keywords that have become unprofitable.

actions.message: Bid ridotto del 20% per ACOS > 1.0

rules.name: Pause underperforming target
rules.description: When a target (keyword or ASIN) has spent ≥ €20 with zero sales, pauses the ad-group containing it. Trade-off: the action is coarse (pauses the whole ad-group, not just the target) because Amazon Ads does not expose a reliable bid-zero. Operator can refine manually.

actions.message: Ad-group pausato per target senza vendite

rules.name: Alert: negative advertising margin
rules.description: Notifies the operator when a campaign's ad spend over the last 30 days exceeds the true profit of the products it advertises. Notify-only — operator decides the corrective action (budget cut, pause, creative change).

actions.message: Spesa pubblicitaria > profitto reale negli ultimi 30g — rivedi la campagna

rules.name: Boost budget on profitable campaigns
rules.description: When ACOS is low (< 0.20) and impressions > 5000, suggests a +15% increase to the campaign daily budget (respecting maxDailyAdSpendCentsEur). Dry-run by default — operator approves auto-up per campaign.

actions.message: Budget aumentato del 15% su campagna ad alto ROAS

rules.name: Scale budget-capped winners
rules.description: When a campaign's 7-day ROAS ≥ 4 and it is using ≥ 85% of its daily budget (i.e. capped), raises the daily budget +20% (within guardrails). Dry-run by default.

actions.message: Budget +20% on a budget-capped high-ROAS campaign

rules.name: Trim budget on weak ACOS
rules.description: When a campaign's 7-day ACOS ≥ 0.40 (well above target) with meaningful spend, lowers the daily budget −15% to stem the bleed. Dry-run by default.

actions.message: Budget −15% on a high-ACOS campaign

rules.name: Auto harvest & negate
rules.description: Every run: negates search terms that spent €10+ with zero orders (wasted spend), and promotes terms with 2+ orders to exact-match campaigns (free traffic recovery). The #1 automation feature. Runs up to 3 times per day via the SCHEDULE trigger. Dry-run by default — review the execution log before going live.

actions.message: Harvest & negate ran — check execution log for terms moved

rules.name: Retail guard
rules.description: Every 15 min: automatically pauses campaigns advertising out-of-stock products or products that lost the Buy Box — so you never pay for traffic you can't convert. Resumes when products are back in stock. Dry-run by default.

actions.message: Retail guard ran — see the execution log for any campaigns it paused

rules.name: Monthly budget cap
rules.description: Instantly pauses ALL enabled campaigns the moment your monthly ad spend hits your cap. Guaranteed never-overspend. Set your cap in the condition (default €2,000 — adjust to your budget). Dry-run by default — enable live when you're ready.

actions.message: ⛔ Monthly budget cap hit — all campaigns paused

rules.name: Profit-native bid optimisation
rules.description: Runs daily: nudges every keyword bid toward each product's true-profit ACOS target, with Bayesian smoothing for low-data keywords. Raises winners, cuts losers. This is the €500+/mo feature other tools sell — built in.

actions.message: Profit bid optimisation ran — see execution log

rules.name: Bid optimization (profit-native)
rules.description: Runs daily: adjusts every keyword bid toward its product's true profit-based ACOS target using Bayesian smoothing for low-data keywords. Raises bids on underperforming winners, cuts bids on losers. This is the primary thing PPC tools charge €500+/mo for — built in.

actions.message: Bid optimization ran — check execution log for changes

rules.name: Zero-impression kill
rules.description: Immediately pauses keywords that are spending budget but getting ZERO impressions — a sign of delivery failure, suppressed listing, or bad match. Catches waste that ACOS rules can't see (no impressions = no ACOS).

actions.message: 🔇 Keyword spending with zero impressions — paused for review

rules.name: Low CTR bid reduction
rules.description: Cuts bids 25% on keywords with >500 impressions but CTR < 0.2%. Low CTR = poor relevance = wasted impressions. Better to bid less and appear for more qualified traffic.

actions.message: Low CTR detected — bid reduced 25%

rules.name: CVR drop alert + bid cut
rules.description: When a keyword's conversion rate drops >40% week-over-week, cuts the bid 20% and alerts. CVR drops signal competitor price cuts, review score degradation, or listing quality issues — act immediately.

actions.message: CVR drop detected — bid reduced 20%

rules.name: Wasted keyword instant negate
rules.description: Negates any keyword that spent €5+ with 5+ clicks and ZERO orders in 14 days. Fires in real-time (every 15 min) rather than waiting for the daily harvest run — stops waste hours faster.

rules.name: Auto match-type migration (broad → exact)
rules.description: When a search term from a broad/phrase campaign gets 2+ orders, automatically promotes it to an exact-match keyword in the same ad group AND negates it to prevent cannibalization. The full match-type funnel on autopilot.

actions.message: Search term promoted to exact-match

rules.name: Account-wide negative sync
rules.description: When a search term wastes €10+ with zero orders, negates it across EVERY campaign in the marketplace simultaneously. Stops one bad term from bleeding across your whole account.

actions.message: Cross-account negative added

rules.name: Top-of-Search rank defender
rules.description: When impression share drops (detected via low-impressions campaigns), raises all bids 25% to reclaim position. Guards high-value campaigns from being outbid by competitors without manual intervention.

actions.message: Impression loss detected — bids raised and ToS multiplier increased

rules.name: Profit protection (pause on margin breach)
rules.description: When advertising spend exceeds net margin (you're losing money on every sale), immediately pauses the campaign. The bottom-line guardrail — ensures ads are always profitable.

actions.reason: Margin breach — ad spend exceeds net profit

actions.message: ⚠️ Profit protection triggered — campaign paused (spending more than you make)

rules.name: Aggressive growth: raise bids on low-ACOS winners
rules.description: Raises bids 20% on keywords with ACOS below 15% and 3+ orders. Doubles down on what's already working — the compounding flywheel that separates growing brands from flat ones.

rules.name: Bulk bid floor protection
rules.description: When a keyword is paused by automation, sets its bid to the minimum (€0.05) instead. This keeps it eligible for re-evaluation data while minimizing waste if it's accidentally re-enabled.

actions.message: Keyword bid floored — reviewing performance

rules.name: Campaign ACOS rebalance (cut + scale)
rules.description: When campaign ACOS is over 50% AND there's another campaign under 20% ACOS, cuts the bad campaign's budget 20% and raises the winner's budget 20%. Automatically shifts money to what works.

actions.message: High-ACOS campaign budget cut 20% — manual review recommended

rules.name: Weekend budget boost
rules.description: Raises budgets 30% on Fridays and Saturdays (via dayparting bid multiplier) and restores Sunday — matches higher weekend shopping volume without overspending weekdays.

actions.message: Weekend optimization cycle complete

rules.name: Stale campaign cleanup
rules.description: Archives keywords that have ZERO impressions AND zero clicks in 30 days. Dead keywords hurt Quality Scores and clutter your account. Keep it clean automatically.

actions.message: Stale keyword archived (30-day no activity)

rules.name: FBA in-stock resume
rules.description: When a paused campaign's products come back into stock, automatically re-enables the campaign. Works as the complement to retail guard — full pause/resume lifecycle without manual intervention.

actions.message: Retail guard evaluated — check log for paused/resumed campaigns

rules.name: Daily automation digest
rules.description: Every morning: runs a dry-run of bid optimization and harvesting and sends an alert with what WOULD change. The daily briefing — see what automation would do before it does it.

actions.message: Daily automation digest — see execution log for proposed changes

rules.name: Target ACOS setter (from profit)
rules.description: Runs daily: recalculates each campaign's optimal target ACOS from the product's real profit margin and updates the stored target. As your costs change, your bid targets stay correct automatically.

actions.message: Profit-native ACOS targets updated

rules.name: New-to-brand optimizer
rules.description: Raises bids 10% on campaigns where >30% of orders are new-to-brand (from ntbOrders14d data). New-to-brand orders are worth more — acquire customers at a premium and LTV justifies the bid.

actions.message: NTB campaign bid raised — high new-customer acquisition rate

rules.name: ACoS convergence (proportional correction)
rules.description: Every 6 hours: adjusts bids proportionally using the formula bid × (target_ACOS / actual_ACOS). The cleanest bid-optimization formula — mathematically guaranteed to converge toward target ACOS.

actions.message: Proportional ACOS correction applied

rules.name: Scale budget on ROAS winners
rules.description: Raises daily budget 25% on campaigns achieving ROAS > 5x. These campaigns are generating €5+ for every €1 spent — more budget = more profit. Compound your winners.

actions.message: 🏆 High-ROAS campaign budget raised 25%

rules.name: Exact match discovery engine

actions.message: Exact match discovery ran — check execution log for new keywords

actions.message: ⛔ Monthly cap hit — all campaigns paused
